_comment: JSON schema representations of the MoMo SMS database entities. Mirrors database_setup.sql exactly (table/column names, types, nullability). Author: Hussaina Abubakar Shehu (JSON Modeling & Documentation)

User._description: Represents a row in the `users` table

PhoneNumber.description: Contact phone number, must be unique

Transaction._description: Represents a row in the `transactions` table

UserID.description: Foreign key referencing users.UserID (the user who made the transaction)

Transaction_Category._description: Represents a row in the `transaction_categories` table

CategoryName.description: Name of the transaction category (e.g. Transfer, Payment, Withdrawal)

Transaction_Category_Mapping._description: Represents a row in the junction table `transaction_category_mapping`, resolving the many-to-many relationship between Transactions and Transaction_Categories

System_Log._description: Represents a row in the `system_logs` table

UserID.description: Foreign key referencing users.UserID, nullable (set NULL if the user is deleted)

LogDate.description: When the log entry was created

Complete_Transaction_Example._description: A complete, API-ready JSON object for a single transaction, with related sender, category, and log data nested inside — this is how a client-facing endpoint (e.g. GET /transactions/101) would serialize the joined data from transactions, users, transaction_categories, transaction_category_mapping, and system_logs
